general_rules.name: tutoiement_equipe_interne
general_rules.description: Use tu form with direct team members (Pierre, Lucas, Camille) in internal emails
general_rules.trigger: Internal techcorp.fr email to direct reports or peers
general_rules.action: Use casual tone, first name greeting, first name only closing

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_clients_externes
general_rules.description: Always use vous form with external clients and formal title on first contact
general_rules.action: Use Madame/Monsieur on first emails, full signature with title and phone

general_rules.name: signature_complete_externe
general_rules.description: Always include full signature (name, title, company, phone) for external contacts
general_rules.trigger: Email to external domain (clients, suppliers, partners)
general_rules.action: Add full signature: Sophie Martin / Chef de projet - Division Digitale / TechCorp | +33 6 12 34 56 78

general_rules.name: signature_prenom_interne
general_rules.description: Use first name only for internal team emails
general_rules.trigger: Email to techcorp.fr direct team members

general_rules.name: anglais_partenaires_internationaux
general_rules.description: Switch to English for international partners (non-French companies)
general_rules.trigger: Email to .com, .co.kr, .de domains of tech companies
general_rules.action: Write entire email in English, adapt greeting to Hi/Dear based on formality

general_rules.name: listes_numerotees_actions
general_rules.description: Use numbered lists for action items and structured information
general_rules.trigger: Email containing multiple action points or decisions
general_rules.action: Format as numbered list (1. 2. 3.) for clarity

general_rules.name: cc_lead_technique
general_rules.description: CC Pierre Durand (lead technique) on technical discussions with external partners
general_rules.trigger: External email involving technical architecture or API integration
general_rules.action: Add Pierre in CC with explanation in email body

general_rules.name: formule_politesse_ceo
general_rules.description: Use formal greeting and closing for CEO communication

general_rules.name: recap_reunions_structure
general_rules.description: Structure meeting recaps with clear sections and action items
general_rules.action: Use sections: Faits marquants, Actions a suivre, Prochaines etapes

general_rules.name: disponibilite_creneaux_precis
general_rules.description: Provide precise time slots when proposing meetings
general_rules.trigger: Email proposing a meeting or call
general_rules.action: Give specific date/time options with format: Jour JJ/MM : HHhMM-HHhMM
